hook: Federico Viticci builds his first iOS app
hookText: Federico Viticci builds his first iOS app

beats.say: After 45 days and 530 pull requests, Federico Viticci is nearing TestFlight on his first iOS app and has written up his agent setup: T3 Code driving several providers across a pool of Macs with 832 GB of RAM, simulators and a fork of pstack.
It is a concrete look at what a multi-machine, multi-agent iOS setup looks like in practice, including dogfooding and bug filing once the app works.
The post drew 400+ likes and 330k views.
